# setops

Set operation step implementations extending base classes from `../../Steps.js` with auto-registry integration. Wraps `BaseUnionStep`, `BaseIntersectStep`, `BaseQueryUnionStep`, `BaseMultiQueryStep` with JSON deserialization, AST conversion placeholders, and cloning for Gremlin-style graph traversals.

## Contents

- [IntersectStep.ts](./IntersectStep.ts) — `IntersectStep<TSteps>` extends `BaseIntersectStep`. Static `stepName = "Intersect"`, `category = "setops"`. Exports `fromJSON`, `fromAST`, `clone`. Auto-registers via `stepRegistry.register()` on load.
- [MultiQueryStep.ts](./MultiQueryStep.ts) — `MultiQueryStep` extends `BaseMultiQueryStep`. Static `stepName = "MultiQuery"`, `category = "setops"`. Exports `fromJSON` (returns empty statements, recursive deserialization TODO), `fromAST`, `clone`. Auto-registers on load.
- [QueryUnionStep.ts](./QueryUnionStep.ts) — `QueryUnionStep` extends `BaseQueryUnionStep`. Static `stepName = "QueryUnion"`, `category = "setops"`. Exports `fromJSON`, `fromAST`, `clone`. Auto-registers on load.
- [UnionStep.ts](./UnionStep.ts) — `UnionStep<TSteps>` extends `BaseUnionStep`. Static `stepName = "Union"`, `category = "setops"`. Exports `fromJSON` (returns empty steps, nested deserialization TODO), `fromAST`, `clone`. Auto-registers on load.
- [index.ts](./index.ts) — Barrel exports `UnionStep`, `IntersectStep`, `QueryUnionStep`, `MultiQueryStep` and config types `UnionStepConfig`, `IntersectStepConfig`, `QueryUnionStepConfig`, `MultiQueryStepConfig` from `../../Steps.js`.

## Subdirectories

- [**tests**/](__tests__/) — Unit tests validating registry integration, JSON serialization roundtrips, and cloning behavior.

## API Surface

Barrel `index.ts` aggregates four step classes. Side-effect registration occurs on import of any step file via `stepRegistry.register({ name, category, constructor })`. Enables dynamic instantiation via `stepRegistry.create(name, config)`.

## Behavioral Contracts

**JSON Deserialization Formats:**

- `IntersectStep.fromJSON`: `["Intersect", {}, [...nestedSteps]]`
- `UnionStep.fromJSON`: `["Union", {}, [...nestedSteps]]` — returns empty steps (nested deserialization TODO)
- `QueryUnionStep.fromJSON`: `["QueryUnion"|"QueryUnionAll", {all: boolean}, ...branches]`
- `MultiQueryStep.fromJSON`: `["MultiQuery", {}, [...statements]]` — returns empty statements (recursive deserialization TODO)

**Null Return Conditions:** `fromJSON` returns `null` for: `null` input, wrong step name arrays, insufficient data, type mismatches. `fromAST` returns `null` (unimplemented placeholder).

**Static Properties:** All classes define `static stepName: string` ("Union", "Intersect", "QueryUnion", "MultiQuery") and `static category: "setops"`.

**Clone Signature:** `clone(partial?: Partial<Config>): StepClass` creates new instance with recursively cloned nested steps and merged partial config.

## File Relationships

All step classes extend base implementations from `../../Steps.js`. Import `stepRegistry` from `../StepRegistry.js` for registration side effects. Import `AST` type from `../../AST.js`, `ASTConversionContext` type from `../StepRegistry.js` for method signatures.

## Patterns

**Registry Auto-Registration:** Each module executes `stepRegistry.register({ name: Class.stepName, category: Class.category, constructor: Class })` at load time.

**Base Class Extension:** Concrete steps add only JSON deserialization and registry integration, inheriting traversal logic from base classes.

**Tuple Validation:** `fromJSON` methods validate array format `[stepName, configObject, ...children]` before instantiation.
